title: Crosswinds Golf Club
specs: Driving range with multi-tiered all grass tees
Proper golf attire required: collared shirts or turtlenecks, Bermuda length walking shorts; no tank tops, t-shirts, sweat pants, gym style or short shorts, or denim
Golf shoes must have soft spikes
All players must have their own set of clubs unless renting
Large groups or bookings over 7 days in advance require outing reservations worksheet
Tournaments and leagues available; contact Pro Shop for details

blurb: Crosswinds Golf Club offers 9 and 18 hole golf rounds with cart fees included. They provide golf club rentals and a driving range with multi-tiered all grass tees. The club hosts tournaments, leagues, lessons, and special events.
extraNote: Tee time cancellations accepted 24 hours before tee time; after that full payment required · Groups responsible for full payment including no shows; call Pro Shop ASAP for no shows · Deposit required within 10 business days upon contract for outings; 100% applied to final bill · If event cancelled by client, deposit refunded only if cancellation in writing 4 months prior and substitute booking found · Rain checks issued only if course closed due to weather and fewer than 9 holes played; no rain checks after teeing off first hole or after 9 holes · All food and beverages must be purchased on site; no outside food or alcohol allowed
